newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Libya to celebrate Eid al-Fitr on Saturday.
newsitem.headline: Libya to celebrate Eid al-Fitr on Saturday.

text.p: Libya will celebrate Eid al-Fitr marking the end of the Moslem fasting month of Ramadan on Saturday.

The official Libyan news agency JANA quoted Libyan space and astronomy observatory as saying the lunar crescent marking the start of the new month would be seen in western Libya on Friday afternoon. Saturday and Sunday will be public holidays.
